technique_name: Write a story about a scientist who discovers a planet.
description: Dr. Dan Potter was a brilliant astrophysicist who had dedicated his life to studying the cosmos. One day, while studying a faraway star system, dr. Potter stumbled upon an unexpected anomaly. As he quickly adjusted the telescope's settings to get a better view of the anomaly, his heart began to race. It was a planet!
